title: UI pattern catalog
description: One decision per recurring UI question: the options considered, the option chosen, how it changes on a compact screen, and where each frontend implements it. The catalog names behaviour and structure, never a component library, so one catalog serves every frontend platform.

registry.description: The command or path that renders every option of every pattern for visual review.

breakpoints.description: Named viewport widths in CSS pixels. A compact variant names one of these.

reference.description: The product or guideline the option follows.

question.description: The recurring question the pattern answers.

source.description: owner: a person with the authority chose it. recommended: the reviewer's recommendation stands until an owner chooses.

note.description: What the owner added to the chosen option.

record.description: A decision record that changed the choice after it was first made.

breakpoint.description: A key of the catalog breakpoints. Below it the compact behaviour applies.

option.description: A different option used below the breakpoint. Absent when the chosen option reflows.

extensions.description: Further options a reader may switch to, such as a dense view, beside the chosen default.

library.description: The id of the standards UI pattern library pattern this entry starts from. Its options keep the library's option ids, and the entry may add options of its own.

implementations.description: Keyed by frontend platform, such as react-web or blazor-web.

status.description: adopted: every surface follows the chosen option. partial: the shared implementation exists and some surfaces do not use it yet. pending: no implementation yet. not-applicable: the platform has no such surface.

components.description: Source paths of the shared implementation, relative to the workspace root.

gap.description: What is missing, for a partial or pending status.
